name: ostiary
description: Usher formation and meeting organization for Catholic parishes

scripts.seed:local: npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute ostiary-db --local --file=./.seed.sql --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.seed:remote: npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute ostiary-db --remote --file=./.seed.sql
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:init:local && npm run seed:local
